subject: Quick note on Essex Steel's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Essex Steel stood out.

35+ years fabricating from Rochford near Southend Airport - yet essexsteelfabrications.co.uk still runs on old .asp pages and ends the homepage with stock "medical team" photos that have nothing to do with steelwork. The workshop story is real; the site still borrows the wrong images.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
